Author: Vivek Rusia
Bench: Vivek Rusia

1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE  CRA No. 12219 of 2022  (PRAKASH Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH )
 Dated : 10-01-2025  Shri Ashish Gupta, Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Bhuwan Gautam, Government Advocate for the respond Heard on I.A.No.17927/2024, which is first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the appellant for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

sentences.text: 2. Appellant stands convicted vide judgement dated 10.12.2022 passed by the Special Judge, POCSO Act, Ratlam in SC/205/2019 u/S 376(3) and 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- and RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that there is no allegation against the appellant that he committed sexual assault.
At the time of incident, prosecutrix was minor.
Prosecutrix is having a child and is living somewhere else.
There is no other member in the family to look after them.

She has been found below 18 years of age on the basis of scholar register but apart from that, no other document like birth certificate or hospital record has been produced to establish the date of birth recorded in the scholar register.
Appellant has completed jail incarceration of 05 years and she was also a consenting party for sexual intercourse.

Also this appeal is not likely to come up for final hearing in near future, therefore, keeping in view the 2 CRA-12219-2022 period of custody, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
4. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the aforesaid application and prays for its rejection.

5. Keeping in view the facts in totality and considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, we are of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence moved on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.

6. Accordingly, I.A.No.17927/2024 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the Prakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19897078/

sentences.text: 1 appellant is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that appellant Prakash be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 10.03.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List in due course.
Certified copy, as per rules.
(VIVEK RUSIA)
